Package com.eventlottery.model

Class Waitlist

java.lang.Object
com.eventlottery.model.Waitlist
public class Waitlist extends Object
Manages the waitlist for a specific event. Tracks attendees who are waiting to join an event and enforces capacity limits if set. Automatically synchronizes changes with Firebase Firestore.
